title: Rooftop Jazz in Two Formats
tests: Checks delivery of two correctly composed aspect-ratio variants with matching event content, readable overlays and no letterboxing.

faults.what: Only one 10-second portrait video is supplied; the required separate 16:9 version is missing.
The event title reads 'Roofop Jazz', omitting the 't' in 'Rooftop'.
The location reads 'Sky Terrace, Mansether' rather than 'Sky Terrace, Manchester'.
An unrequested fourth line, 'Sky Turacce, 2026', adds garbled and confusing event information.

judge.summary: A full-frame sunset rooftop performance is shown in portrait format, but misspelled event text and the missing landscape version make the delivery unusable as requested.

must_haves.item: Two separate playable videos are delivered, each 10 seconds long: one 9:16 and one 16:9.
Both versions show rooftop musicians at sunset with consistent styling and event content.
must_haves.why: The supplied clip shows a consistently styled rooftop trio at sunset, but no second version is delivered.

must_haves.item: Both versions display exactly 'Rooftop Jazz', '18 July 2026' and 'Sky Terrace, Manchester'.
must_haves.why: The title and city are misspelled in the supplied clip, and the second version is absent.

must_haves.item: All three text lines are fully inside each frame and readable together for at least 3 seconds.
must_haves.why: The visible text remains inside the portrait frame across the sampled times, but the required title and location are not correctly displayed, and there is no landscape version.

must_haves.item: Both compositions fill their frames without black bars, stretched imagery or cropped-off musicians' faces.
must_haves.why: The portrait composition fills its frame with no visible black bars, stretching, or cropped faces, but the required landscape composition is missing.

must_haves.item: Both videos contain mellow jazz and no voiceover.
must_haves.why: The transcript contains no intelligible speech, but it cannot establish the music's genre or mood; no second video is supplied.
